beats.say: Its heart can beat over twelve hundred times a minute.
The hummingbird. It hovers in place, wings a blur.
A ruby-throat beats its wings about fifty times a second.
It's the only bird that can truly fly backwards.
That tiny heart races just to keep it in the air.
So every night, it powers down to save energy.
Its body cools, and its heart slows way down.
The smallest kind, the bee hummingbird, weighs about two grams.
A heart this fast, in a bird this small.
